newsitem.title: USA: Liposome Co says Canada oks drug marketing.
newsitem.headline: Liposome Co says Canada oks drug marketing.

text.p: Liposome Co Inc said Tuesday Canada granted marketing approval for its anti-fungal drug ABELCET.

The company said it developed ABELCET to treat systemic fungal infections such as candidiasis, aspergillosis and cryptococcal meningitis -- diseases associated with fatality rates of up to 90 percent.
These fungal infections most often attack patients with suppressed immune systems, usually resulting from AIDS and therapies for cancer, solid organ and bone marrow transplants.
Worldwide sales of ABELCET in 1996 were $52.8 million.
